# A round meadow tree: a 6-sided trunk, two faceted crowns. 2.6 m tall. Up Z.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.522 0.298 0.188 --no-slot
material new Leaves --base-color 0.427 0.667 0.173 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 1.2 --location 0 0 0.6
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.95 --location 0 0 1.7
material assign Leaves
add mesh ico-sphere --name Crown2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.6 --location 0.35 -0.2 2.3
material assign Leaves
mode edit
select all
randomize --amount 0.06 --seed 3
mode object
select all
shade flat
export tree.glb
